name: form
title: Form
description: Semantic form wrapper with dual-mode validation. Native mode (v0.6) is the default — manual `validate` callback, blur-validation, focus-on-first-error. RHF mode (v0.7) activates when a Zod `schema` prop is passed — wraps children in a FormProvider, auto-registers nested Fields by `name`, and surfaces field-level errors automatically.
